tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find products that do a job, from every launch NowFound has indexed. Describe the job in plain words, for example "invoice tool for freelancers". Returns up to 20 products as Markdown: name, what it does, launch date, votes, price where checked, and its NowFound page to cite. Set mcp_only to search

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Everything NowFound knows about one product, as Markdown: what it does, launch date, votes, website, pricing where checked, products that do a similar job, and its NowFound page to cite. Pass the product's NowFound page, its slug, or its own website. Use search_products instead when you only know th

tools.name: add_product
tools.description: List a product on NowFound, free and with no account. The maker gets one email and the product goes live when they open the link. Use it only for the maker or with their permission. The answer lists optional next steps for the maker, such as a badge for their site. Call check_listing later to see wh

tools.name: check_listing
tools.description: After add_product, see whether the product went live. Pass the product's website and the maker's email used to add it. Answers live with its page, waiting_for_email while the maker has not opened the link (with when it stops working), link_expired, or not_found. A product not yet live is only report

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: add_product, check_listing · Private data: search_products · Public sink: add_product, check_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: add_product, check_listing · Private data: search_products · Public sink: add_product, check_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
